item.title: INFINIT opens its second APEX vault – Link The team opened deposits for APEX 2 o
item.description:
INFINIT opens its second APEX vault – Link

The team opened deposits for APEX 2 on Oct 28, following the completion of its first 90-day trading vault on Hyperliquid.

During APEX 1, the team managed to achieve a 35% APR and outperformed all traditional indices like the S&P 500, KOSPI, HSE, etc.

INFINIT also provides access to onchain trading activity and weekly performance reports, allowing users to see how their funds were managed throughout the first round.

APEX 2 brings back the same managers, who plan to apply the same successful strategy, further benefiting from the data and live trading experience of the past three months.

Deposits close on Nov 11.

A successful second round could help establish APEX as a serious option for users looking to access professionally managed trading strategies.

item.title: Aave freezes 292 reserves across Aave V3/V4 within 90 minutes of Binance hack re
item.description:
Aave freezes 292 reserves across Aave V3/V4 within 90 minutes of Binance hack reaching its markets – Link

Aave's guardian multisigs froze 175 reserves across 16 networks on Aave V3 and 117 reserves on V4 after a Binance exploiter deposited 60M USDT and borrowed about 19,762 WETH (≈$44.6M) through the protocol. Markets have since reopened, but nine assets remain at zero LTV as a precaution.

The rapid response may support confidence in DeFi risk management, but it also shows that "immutable" protocols still rely on emergency intervention powers.

item.title: Uniswap absorbs Binance-hacker token dump without derailing uptrend – Link A wal
item.description:
Uniswap absorbs Binance-hacker token dump without derailing uptrend – Link

A wallet linked to the Binance hacker sold millions of UNI tokens on-chain, including dumping $5M of PROM for only $71 in ETH in a thin pool. UNI still gained roughly 3% over 24 hours.

Underlying demand, partly tied to Uniswap's expanding TJAR fee-conversion program across seven chains, is outweighing sell pressure for now.

item.title: Institutional investors pull funds from exchanges, spot ETFs show mixed flows –
item.description:
Institutional investors pull funds from exchanges, spot ETFs show mixed flows – Link

Following the Binance hack, institutional investors accelerated withdrawals from centralized exchanges more broadly, not just Binance. BTC spot ETFs saw a 4th straight day of modest net inflows (+$17.2M on Oct. 29), while ETH ETFs recorded continued outflows (-$105.5M on Oct. 29).

The divergence shows institutional risk appetite was already cooling in ETH before the exchange shock, which could pressure ETH relative to BTC near term.

item.title: Canton Strategic Holdings plans first SEC-compliant tokenized US stock trading o
item.description:
Canton Strategic Holdings plans first SEC-compliant tokenized US stock trading on Nov. 2 – Link

Nasdaq-listed Canton Strategic Holdings (CNTN) announced a deal with tokenized securities venue TSV to trade its own common stock in issuer-initiated tokenized form starting as early as Nov. 2. The company aims to be the first compliant onshore tokenized US equity trade under the SEC's Innovation Exemption Framework.

• Tokenized shares carry the same rights as Nasdaq shares.
• Trading will happen via an AMM for near 24/7 settlement.

If the launch proceeds smoothly, it could set a template for other issuers and signal early regulatory traction for tokenized equities in the US.

item.title: Polymarket front-end exploit adds to risk-off sentiment alongside Binance hack –
item.description:
Polymarket front-end exploit adds to risk-off sentiment alongside Binance hack – Link

Separately from Binance, Polymarket users reported unauthorized asset transfers and suspicious withdrawal signature requests on Oct. 29, suspected to be a front-end attack. One user alone reported an $800K loss, and Polymarket has not yet confirmed the cause.

Standard Chartered said the Binance hack plus the Polymarket exploit could keep crypto under pressure before a base is found. The cluster of security incidents may be eroding confidence in platform security.

item.title: Ice partners with Trade[XYZ] to bring Hyperliquid perpetual futures to the US –
item.description:
Ice partners with Trade[XYZ] to bring Hyperliquid perpetual futures to the US – Link

Intercontinental Exchange signed an agreement with Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated perpetual futures built on the Hyperliquid protocol for the US market. The move points to mainstream, regulated access to on-chain perps.

It adds traditional-finance validation to Hyperliquid's infrastructure and may support further institutional adoption if the product launches as planned.

item.title: Binance suffers suspected $5.8–6.3B hack, largest in crypto history – Link Binan
item.description:
Binance suffers suspected $5.8–6.3B hack, largest in crypto history – Link

Binance detected a suspected breach late Oct. 29 UTC, with on-chain trackers estimating $5.6–6.3B in abnormal outflows across Ethereum, Bitcoin, Tron, and L2s. Binance says the issue may stem from a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop, has suspended deposits and withdrawals, and says it will cover losses via SAFU. Tether and Circle have already frozen over $2.3B in USDT/USDC tied to the attacker.

The attack is denting exchange trust industry-wide and triggered a sharp selloff, with BTC falling from ≈$81K to below $77K and ETH toward $2,200. Liquidity stress and risk-off trading could persist until recovery and freezes are finalized.

item.title: Aave freezes ≈292 reserves across 16+ networks following Binance hack – Link Aav
item.description:
Aave freezes ≈292 reserves across 16+ networks following Binance hack – Link

Aave's risk provider LlamaRisk, together with Aave Labs and Aave Guardians, froze all cross-chain markets as a precaution after the Binance hot wallet breach. The freeze covers 175 reserves across 16 networks on Aave V3, plus 117 reserves on four spoke chains in Aave V4, with phased unfreezing planned once attacker fund flows stop.

This is a major DeFi-wide risk-management response and shows systemic contagion controls activating quickly across the largest lending protocol.

item.title: Chainlink launches "Chainlink 24/7" market data service with Aave as flagship pa
item.description:
Chainlink launches "Chainlink 24/7" market data service with Aave as flagship partner – Link

Chainlink introduced a round-the-clock pricing feed for traditional assets on-chain, covering weekends and holidays by blending 24/5 session data with aggregated perpetual-market quotes after hours. Aave's institutional lending platform Horizon is the first integration, using it to price tokenized RWA collateral.

• Chainlink says it already supports pricing for over $1.6B in tokenized stocks across six chains.
• Partners include Ondo, Robinhood, and Coinbase.

Continuous, reliable pricing is a prerequisite for scaling tokenized RWA lending markets.

item.title: Binance hacked. Here's what we know so far ▪️ Binance’s October 29 breach appear
item.description:
Binance hacked.
Here's what we know so far

▪️ Binance’s October 29 breach appears to involve compromised withdrawal and signing infrastructure.

▪️ Binance estimates $6.3 billion affected, with approximately $3 billion frozen.

▪️ Its preliminary investigation points to a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop.

Full read here.

item.title: Hifi Finance suffers DAO governance takeover; about $1M in user collateral drain
item.description:
Hifi Finance suffers DAO governance takeover; about $1M in user collateral drained – Link

An address funded via Tornado Cash cast last-minute votes to seize control of Hifi Finance's governance, then minted 25 million additional HIFI tokens and transferred out roughly $1M in user collateral, mostly RWA tokens.

It highlights ongoing governance-attack risk in smaller DeFi protocols and may push other DAOs to review voting-timelock and quorum safeguards.

item.title: DTCC launches blockchain tokenization service with JPMorgan, Citi and Morgan Sta
item.description:
DTCC launches blockchain tokenization service with JPMorgan, Citi and Morgan Stanley among 20 participating firms – Link

DTCC's subsidiary went live on Canton Network and Besu, tokenizing an initial batch of 34 securities 1:1 backed by assets in its roughly $30 trillion custody base. The service uses shared CUSIP codes for 24/7 wallet-to-wallet transfers.

This is a major institutional validation of tokenized securities infrastructure and could support longer-term growth in RWA tokenization volumes.

item.title: Visa reports stablecoin settlement volume surpasses $25B annualized, up about 10
item.description:
Visa reports stablecoin settlement volume surpasses $25B annualized, up about 10x year-over-year – Link

Visa said it now processes stablecoins and tokenized deposits across 10 blockchains and settles five stablecoins: USDC, USDG, EURC, PYUSD and SBC. It also reported 225+ stablecoin-linked card programs, up 70% year-over-year.

This points to accelerating real-world payment adoption of stablecoins and continued institutional growth in stablecoin infrastructure.

item.title: Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launch first licensed tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund o
item.description:
Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launch first licensed tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar – Link

Janus Henderson partnered with Centrifuge to launch an issuer-sponsored, licensed tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar. The product gives eligible non-U.S. investors on-chain exposure to the index and is directly issuer-backed rather than a third-party synthetic token.

It supports the legitimacy of tokenized RWA products and is a constructive signal for Stellar's institutional DeFi narrative.

item.title: Robinhood to integrate Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin despite backing rival USDG – Li
item.description:
Robinhood to integrate Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin despite backing rival USDG – Link

Ripple and Robinhood said RLUSD will roll out on Robinhood's main app later this year. RLUSD is already live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, and Robinhood will also use Ripple Treasury for internal treasury and settlement operations.

The deal expands RLUSD distribution to Robinhood's 28.6M customers, but adoption still depends on the app rollout.

item.title: Major U.S. banks deepen reliance on Coinbase crypto infrastructure – Link Coinba
item.description:
Major U.S. banks deepen reliance on Coinbase crypto infrastructure – Link

Coinbase Institutional Co-CEO Brett Tejpaul said PNC private banking clients can now buy, sell, and hold Bitcoin via Coinbase, JPMorgan is integrating Chase accounts, debit cards, and rewards with Coinbase, and Citibank is using Coinbase for business stablecoin payments.

It suggests major banks are outsourcing more crypto infrastructure to Coinbase rather than building it in-house, which could support Coinbase's institutional revenue base.

item.title: Ripple wins final OCC approval for national trust bank – Link The US Office of t
item.description:
Ripple wins final OCC approval for national trust bank – Link

The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank. That enables Ripple to manage RLUSD stablecoin reserves and offer enterprise digital-asset custody under federal banking supervision.

It moves a major stablecoin issuer further into regulated banking infrastructure and may reduce counterparty risk perception for RLUSD.

item.title: Chainlink launches CustodySync, linking institutional custody to DeFi lending –
item.description:
Chainlink launches CustodySync, linking institutional custody to DeFi lending – Link

Chainlink launched CustodySync, letting qualified custodians allow institutional clients to use custodied assets as DeFi lending collateral without transferring custody. Anchorage Digital is the launch partner.

• Chainlink cited a ≈$700B digital custody market
• It also cited $80B+ in DeFi lending deposits as the addressable opportunity

The integration could help bring more institutional capital into DeFi lending and support TVL over time.
